etymologies.etymologyHTML: From down +‎ town.

definitions.definition: Of, relating to, or situated in the central business district

quote.citation: 2017 April 6, Samira Shackle, “On the frontline with Karachi’s ambulance drivers”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
quote.text: “Human flesh got stuck to me,” he recalls now, as we sit in the ambulance control centre in downtown Karachi.

definitions.definition: In or towards the central business district.

quote.citation: 1964, Tony Hatch (lyrics and music), “Downtown”, performed by Petula Clark:
quote.text: When you're alone and life is making you lonely / You can always go downtown

definitions.definition: (basketball) Outside the three-point line, or generally far from the basket.
(chiefly US, Canada) The main business part of a city or town, usually located at or near its center.
